# pydantic-stream-file
> High-performance O(1) RAM streaming file validation glue layer for Pydantic.

## Summary
pydantic-stream-file acts as the streaming glue between I/O (massive CSV, XML files, S3 bodies) and Pydantic validation. It provides O(1) RAM guarantees, vectorized batch validation via Pydantic-core, and Dead Letter Queue error isolation.

## Core API
- `StreamValidator(adapter, model, on_error='raise', batch_size=1000)`: Synchronous stream validator (default `on_error='raise'`).
- `StreamValidatorAsync(adapter, model, on_error='raise', batch_size=1000)`: Asynchronous stream validator (default `on_error='raise'`).
- `StreamResult[T]`: Returned in 'yield_result' mode. Attributes: `is_valid` (bool), `item` (Optional[T]), `raw_data` (dict), `error` (Optional[ValidationError]), `location` (str).
- `ErrorPolicy`: Enum with `RAISE = 'raise'`, `SKIP = 'skip'`, `YIELD_RESULT = 'yield_result'`.
- `adapters.CsvAdapter(source, delimiter=',', quotechar='"', null_values=('', 'NULL', 'N/A'))`: CSV reader supporting multiline cells and sentinel coercion.
- `adapters.XmlAdapter(source, target_tag, context_tags=(), strip_namespaces=True, attr_prefix='@')`: O(1) RAM XML streaming adapter with subtree pruning and parent context extraction.
